metadata.failure_mode: directly observed capacity insufficiency without exhaustive inventory

evidence_manifest.notes: Official BNPB public report quoting the North Luwu BPBD secretary on current evacuation-site needs. It is condition evidence, not an exhaustive live resource inventory.

metadata.claim_boundary: A local emergency authority directly stated that evacuation tents were still needed and buildings were being used to anticipate tent shortage. This establishes an observed shelter-capacity deficit without claiming that every possible shelter resource is absent.

needs.location_ref: North Luwu evacuation sites, South Sulawesi, Indonesia
needs.notes: North Luwu BPBD said evacuation tents were still needed and affected residents were using buildings to anticipate a tent shortage.

reference.historical_action: Emergency shelter and basic-needs support continued while more than fourteen thousand people remained displaced.
reference.historical_outcome_summary: BNPB's 22 July update still recorded 14,483 displaced people and continuing emergency operations. The replay tests recognition of the contemporaneously declared shelter-capacity deficit, not whether a particular later tent delivery caused the eventual outcome.
notes: Later BNPB evidence is hidden from the decision payload.
The capacity finding is supported by direct condition evidence from the local emergency authority; it must not be derived from missing inventory entries.
